app.name: Alpha File Manager
app.description: is developed on top of Sigma File Manager, adding practical features such as a directory tree, quick switching (path focus sync for file dialogs) and batch rename. Many details have been refined to deliver a more complete file manager experience.

mcp.title: MCP server (for AI agents)
mcp.description: Let AI clients such as Claude or Cursor call this app's read-only capabilities over MCP. Off by default — when off, no port is opened at all.

modeDescriptions.off: The server does not start and no port is opened. Nothing on this machine can reach it.
modeDescriptions.readOnly: Exposes directory listing, drives, mountable devices, the indexed global search, directory size and favourites. Entirely read-only — no file is ever modified.
modeDescriptions.writable: Adds write operations on top of read-only. Deletion still goes to the recycle bin, never a hard delete.
modeDescriptions.askEachTime: Same as writable, but every write operation needs individual confirmation.

mcp.copyFailed: Copy failed — please copy the snippet manually
mcp.tokenRotated: New token generated. Previous configs stop working immediately.
mcp.tokenHint: Any process on this machine can reach 127.0.0.1. The token is the only barrier — do not share it.
mcp.indicatorTooltip: An AI client is using this app's capabilities
mcp.deployHint: One-click deploy writes this server straight into the client’s own config file without touching any other entry, and backs the original up as .alpha-mcp.bak beforehand. The change only takes effect after you quit that client completely and start it again.
mcp.deployFailed: Deployment failed — see the error below
mcp.deployAlreadyCurrent: The config was already up to date, so nothing was changed.
mcp.deployDone: Deployed to {client}. Config file: {path}. The original file was backed up as {backup}. Please quit {client} completely and start it again.
mcp.restartTitle: {client} must be fully quit and restarted
mcp.restartBody: The config file is written, but MCP clients only read it at startup — they never reload it while running. Quit {client} from its tray icon (closing the window is not enough), reopen it, then come back here and press Re-check.
mcp.restartBackup: The original file was backed up to {backup}. To undo, rename the backup back.

thumbnailCache.title: Thumbnail cache
thumbnailCache.description: Image and video thumbnails share the same cache directory. Cleared thumbnails are regenerated automatically the next time you browse.
thumbnailCache.clearFailed: Failed to clear the thumbnail cache
thumbnailCache.confirmDescription: This clears both image and video thumbnail caches and cannot be undone. Cleared thumbnails are regenerated the next time you browse those files.

connections.title: Remote connections
connections.description: Save FTP, FTPS and SFTP connections here. Passwords are encrypted with Windows DPAPI and never leave this machine.

password.savedHint: Leave blank to keep the current password.

error.initialPathInvalid: Initial directory contains an invalid segment.
error.proxyPortInvalid: Proxy port must be between 1 and 65535.
error.remoteConnectionsStorageNotReady: The connection list has not finished loading. Please try again in a moment.
error.testInvalidInput: These settings cannot be tested yet. Fill in the server address and port.

localPath.hint: Optional. When set, opening this connection shows a split view: local folder on the left, remote folder on the right.

outcome.verified: Connected. The server accepted these settings.
outcome.auth_rejected: Connected, but the server rejected the username or password.
outcome.missing_credential: Connected, but no password was supplied, so authentication was not verified.
outcome.wrong_protocol: Something answered, but it is not the selected protocol.
outcome.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check the address, port and proxy.
outcome.protocol_error: Connected, but the exchange did not complete as expected.

test.passwordNotChecked: No password was submitted, so this does not confirm that it is correct.
test.tlsNotVerified: The TLS certificate was not verified.

trustedHosts.title: Trusted hosts
trustedHosts.description: Host keys you have confirmed. Remote directories only open after you trust the server here.
trustedHosts.empty: You have not trusted any host yet.
trustedHosts.loadFailed: The trusted host list could not be read.
trustedHosts.forgetFailed: That host could not be removed. It is still on the list.
